turnover-attention-level-and-its-transfo.name: turnover-attention-level-and-its-transforms-level
turnover-attention-level-and-its-transfo.description: Turnover/attention level and its transforms (level, spike-vs-baseline, CV) are the strongest, most robust axis on full-A
turnover-attention-level-and-its-transfo.evidence: R1: turn_low IS ic 0.0895/ICIR 0.59 -> OOS 0.0797; turn_spike, turn_cv also accepted with 3/3 universes, 7/7 years; ivol was even subsumed by turn_low (corr>=0.7). But 3 accepted factors already sit near the 0.7 corr ceiling -> family is close to saturated.

tail-lottery-measures-tsmax-of-returns-n.name: tail-lottery-measures-tsmax-of-returns-negative
tail-lottery-measures-tsmax-of-returns-n.description: Tail/lottery measures (TsMax of returns, negative skew) beat plain volatility — vol factors collapse into them at dedup
tail-lottery-measures-tsmax-of-returns-n.evidence: R1: max_eff IS 0.0832/ICIR 0.74, OOS 0.0909 (stronger OOS than IS); skew accepted; lowvol and amp_low both rejected as duplicates of max_eff. Prefer tail shape over dispersion.

price-volume-agreement-correlations-fade.name: price-volume-agreement-correlations-fade-volume-confirmed
price-volume-agreement-correlations-fade.description: Price-volume agreement correlations (fade volume-confirmed rallies) give the highest ICIR signals
price-volume-agreement-correlations-fade.evidence: R1: pv_corr ICIR 0.97 (best of round), OOS 0.0387; ts-rank variant and smart_flow (TsCorr(TURN,RET)) also accepted. Interaction of price and volume >> either alone.

decompose-close-to-close-returns-into-in.name: decompose-close-to-close-returns-into-intraday
decompose-close-to-close-returns-into-in.description: Decompose close-to-close returns into intraday and overnight legs: intraday leg carries the reversal, overnight leg is MOMENTUM (sign flip vs intuition)
decompose-close-to-close-returns-into-in.evidence: R1: intraday_rev subsumed rev20; overnight gaps positively predict. R2: leg idea kept paying — gap_vol (overnight-leg vol, alpha_0015) IS 0.070 -> OOS 0.085 (stronger OOS), overnight_mom60 accepted (0.042/0.035). But do NOT leg-decompose MAX: max_intraday hit corr 0.90 vs whole-return max_eff.

within-industry-earnings-yield-ep-is-the.name: within-industry-earnings-yield-ep-is-the
within-industry-earnings-yield-ep-is-the.description: Within-industry earnings yield (EP) is the one value signal that clears the bar
within-industry-earnings-yield-ep-is-the.evidence: R1: ep_ind IS 0.0410/ICIR 0.34, OOS 0.0176 (weakest accept, decays ~57%) but 3/3 universes and 7/7 years. Value works but thin at 10d horizon.

demeaned-rank-interaction-terms-csrank-a.name: demeaned-rank-interaction-terms-csrank-a-0
demeaned-rank-interaction-terms-csrank-a.description: Demeaned-rank interaction terms ((CsRank(A)-0.5)*(CsRank(B)-0.5)) mine conditional structure with near-zero correlation to both parents
demeaned-rank-interaction-terms-csrank-a.evidence: R2: rev_x_lowturn (alpha_0018) ICIR -0.65 IS / -0.90 OOS, max corr vs set only 0.17; max_x_spike (alpha_0019) ICIR -0.83 IS. Note the SIGN: both came out negative — names where the two bullish signals AGREE underperform; disagreement (hedged/mixed profiles) outperforms. Template is productive; try other parent pairs.

up-down-semivol-asymmetry-is-the-one.name: up-down-semivol-asymmetry-is-the-one
up-down-semivol-asymmetry-is-the-one.description: Up/down semivol asymmetry is the one orthogonal vol construct
up-down-semivol-asymmetry-is-the-one.evidence: R2: alpha_0016 accepted (IS 0.062/0.58, OOS 0.067/0.74, PFS 0.98) while vol_of_vol and max_intraday died at the corr gate. Downside-dominated vol earns, upside-dominated vol fades.

attention-duration-days-since-turnover-p.name: attention-duration-days-since-turnover-peak-adds
attention-duration-days-since-turnover-p.description: Attention DURATION (days since turnover peak) adds liquidity info orthogonal to turnover level
attention-duration-days-since-turnover-p.evidence: R2: turn_dur (alpha_0017) accepted with max set-corr only 0.47 despite 3 turnover factors already in the set; IS 0.041/0.60, OOS 0.032.

cash-flow-yield-cfp-joins-ep-as.name: cash-flow-yield-cfp-joins-ep-as
cash-flow-yield-cfp-joins-ep-as.description: Cash-flow yield (CFP) joins EP as the second value survivor and holds OOS better
cash-flow-yield-cfp-joins-ep-as.evidence: R2: cfp_ind (alpha_0020) IS 0.033 -> OOS 0.030 vs ep_ind's 0.041 -> 0.018. Cash-based value decays less than earnings-based.

volume-price-interaction-family-keeps-pr.name: volume-price-interaction-family-keeps-producing-3
volume-price-interaction-family-keeps-pr.description: Volume-price interaction family keeps producing (3 rounds running); turnover ELASTICITY to |return| is the best construct yet
volume-price-interaction-family-keeps-pr.evidence: R3: volresp_beta (-RegBeta(TURN_F, Abs(RET), 20), alpha_0024) IS 0.065/ICIR 0.83 (best of round), OOS 0.046/0.60, max set-corr 0.58. Volume response to moves, not volume level, isolates speculation-proneness.

self-relative-time-series-framing-dodges.name: self-relative-time-series-framing-dodges-the
self-relative-time-series-framing-dodges.description: Self-relative (time-series) framing dodges the saturated cross-sectional turnover family
self-relative-time-series-framing-dodges.evidence: R3: turn_selfrank (-TsRank(TURN_F,120), alpha_0022) IS 0.051 -> OOS 0.052, squeaked the corr gate at 0.69 vs the level factor. TS-rank reframing is a general trick, but the turnover axis is now truly full (5 factors) — stop proposing it.

extreme-day-frequency-complements-extrem.name: extreme-day-frequency-complements-extreme-day-magnitude
extreme-day-frequency-complements-extrem.evidence: R3: max_freq (-TsCount(RET > 2*TsStd(RET,60), 60), alpha_0021) IS 0.047 -> OOS 0.046, corr vs max_eff only 0.49.

frequency-bands-are-separable-weekly-ban.name: frequency-bands-are-separable-weekly-band-decayed
frequency-bands-are-separable-weekly-ban.description: Frequency bands are separable: weekly-band decayed intraday reversal is distinct from the monthly sum
frequency-bands-are-separable-weekly-ban.evidence: R3: rev5_decay (-DecayLinear(CLOSE/OPEN-1, 7), alpha_0023) IS 0.041 -> OOS 0.052 (OOS stronger), corr vs alpha_0011 only 0.48, near-zero 10d rank-AC (fast factor).

untested-one-off-data-fields-are-the.name: untested-one-off-data-fields-are-the
untested-one-off-data-fields-are-the.description: Untested one-off data fields are the highest-yield candidate slots
untested-one-off-data-fields-are-the.evidence: R4: limit_up_touch count (alpha_0031) IS 0.077/0.72 OOS 0.057 — best new factor; volume_ratio mean (alpha_0034) accepted. New fields > new transforms of old fields.

self-relative-time-series-framing-dodges.name: self-relative-time-series-framing-dodges-saturated
self-relative-time-series-framing-dodges.description: Self-relative (time-series) framing dodges saturated cross-sectional families
self-relative-time-series-framing-dodges.evidence: R2-R4 running: turn_selfrank, gapvol_selfrank, and amihud_selfrank (alpha_0035 — RESCUED a failed level factor, OOS 0.049 > IS) all accepted. But semivol_selfrank died at corr 0.83 vs its own level version — the trick works across constructs, not within tight ones.

the-max-effect-has-a-min-mirror.name: the-max-effect-has-a-min-mirror
the-max-effect-has-a-min-mirror.description: The MAX effect has a MIN mirror: crash days continue (momentum), lottery days revert
the-max-effect-has-a-min-mirror.evidence: R4: min_eff (-TsMin(RET,20), alpha_0030, direction -1: deep worst-day -> low forward return) IS -0.048 OOS -0.053, corr vs max_eff only 0.58.

systematic-share-r-2-vs-bench-works.name: systematic-share-r-2-vs-bench-works
systematic-share-r-2-vs-bench-works.description: Systematic-share (R^2 vs bench) works with the ANTI-intuitive sign: index-coupled names outperform idiosyncratic stories
systematic-share-r-2-vs-bench-works.evidence: R4: rsq_bench (alpha_0036, direction -1 on -corr^2 i.e. +corr^2 predicts positively) IS 0.051 OOS 0.050, max set-corr only 0.30. Plain beta and semibeta asymmetry are both dead — it's the R^2, not the slope.

lagged-elasticity-decorrelates-from-same.name: lagged-elasticity-decorrelates-from-same-day-elasticity
lagged-elasticity-decorrelates-from-same.description: Lagged elasticity decorrelates from same-day elasticity; fragility (reverse regression) is separate too
lagged-elasticity-decorrelates-from-same.evidence: R4: lag_chase (TsCorr(TURN, Delay(RET,1))) corr 0.41 vs set, accepted; fragility (RegBeta(|RET|,TURN)) corr 0.64, accepted. Same-day asymmetric elasticity (volresp_asym) died at 0.74 vs volresp — direction/lag changes decorrelate, up/down splits of the same regression don't.

long-band-structures-survive-where-short.name: long-band-structures-survive-where-short-bands
long-band-structures-survive-where-short.description: Long-band structures survive where short bands are taken: quarterly intraday reversal and yearly volume clock
long-band-structures-survive-where-short.evidence: R5: intr_mom60 (alpha_0045) IS 0.072 -> OOS 0.072, corr vs the 20d version only 0.54 (bands separable, 3rd confirmation); vol_clock (20d/250d volume share, alpha_0044) IS 0.056 -> OOS 0.076, strongest OOS of the whole set so far.

the-limit-board-field-family-generalizes.name: the-limit-board-field-family-generalizes-recency
the-limit-board-field-family-generalizes.description: The limit-board field family generalizes: recency, one-word boards, post-event returns, and gap/amplitude extreme frequencies all clear
the-limit-board-field-family-generalizes.evidence: R5: limit_recency 0.040/0.56, one_word_cnt, post_limit_ret (OOS ICIR 0.75!), amp_burst_freq, gapdn_freq all accepted. Event count/recency/aftermath on non-return series is a productive class.

cross-quantity-correlations-still-mint-f.name: cross-quantity-correlations-still-mint-factors-attention
cross-quantity-correlations-still-mint-f.description: Cross-quantity correlations still mint factors: attention-risk coupling, aggression-attention, 2-day-lag chase
cross-quantity-correlations-still-mint-f.evidence: R5: attn_risk_corr (TsCorr(TURN, TsStd(RET,5),20)) 0.035/0.61; aggr_attn_corr (close-vs-vwap x turnover); lag_chase2 decorrelated further (0.38 max corr). signed_attn and mean_med_gap also in.

interaction-template-is-now-4-for-6.name: interaction-template-is-now-4-for-6
interaction-template-is-now-4-for-6.evidence: R5: ix_medrev_vr OOS ICIR -0.76 (best interaction yet), ix_limit_gapvol accepted (2/3 universes). Always negative sign: agreement between bullish behavioral signals is consistently bearish.

flow-data-pays-through-coupling-structur.name: flow-data-pays-through-coupling-structure-not
flow-data-pays-through-coupling-structur.description: Flow data pays through COUPLING structure, not levels: flow-return correlations mint factors
flow-data-pays-through-coupling-structur.evidence: R6: mf_ret_corr (-TsCorr(MF_LG_NET, RET, 20), alpha_0052) IS 0.053 -> OOS 0.070/ICIR 0.75, best of round; ret_vr_corr (alpha_0055) replaced alpha_0006 at 1.58x (first replacement executed, registry clean). The R5 cross-quantity-correlation lesson extends to the new flow fields.

event-recency-frequency-and-conditional-.name: event-recency-frequency-and-conditional-aggression-keep
event-recency-frequency-and-conditional-.description: Event recency/frequency and conditional aggression keep minting on fresh quantities
event-recency-frequency-and-conditional-.evidence: R6: amp_burst_rec (HighDay on AMP), vr_burst_freq (VR>2 count), aggr_hi_vr (close-vs-vwap on high-VR days), amp_selfrank all accepted. The trick portfolio: {count, recency, self-rank, conditional-mean} x {any new quantity}.

correlation-constructs-are-band-separabl.name: correlation-constructs-are-band-separable-like-reversal
correlation-constructs-are-band-separabl.description: Correlation constructs are band-separable, like reversal: quarterly versions of accepted 20d couplings clear the corr gate
correlation-constructs-are-band-separabl.evidence: R7: ret_vr_corr60, attn_risk_corr60, lag_chase60 all accepted (OOS 0.038-0.044); med_band60 (quarterly median reversal) OOS 0.070, best of round. But the MF flavor failed: mf_ret_corr60 hit 0.76 vs its own 20d version — band separation works across most, not all, constructs.

mf-coupling-extends-to-second-price-quan.name: mf-coupling-extends-to-second-price-quantities
mf-coupling-extends-to-second-price-quan.description: MF coupling extends to second price quantities: flow-range and flow-aggression correlations
mf-coupling-extends-to-second-price-quan.evidence: R7: mf_amp_corr (OOS 0.041) and mf_vwap_corr (OOS 0.048) accepted; mf_turn_corr and mf_gap_corr died at S1 — the coupling must involve a PRICE-action quantity, not another volume quantity.

burst-frequency-and-burst-recency-are-bo.name: burst-frequency-and-burst-recency-are-both
burst-frequency-and-burst-recency-are-bo.description: Burst-frequency and burst-recency are both mintable per quantity (aggression, VR, gaps)
burst-frequency-and-burst-recency-are-bo.evidence: R7: aggr_burst_freq, vr_burst_rec, gap_burst_rec accepted (recencies at 2/3 universes — smaller-cap leaning).

interaction-template-scales-6-8-accepted.name: interaction-template-scales-6-8-accepted-in
interaction-template-scales-6-8-accepted.description: Interaction template scales: 6/8 accepted in one round when both parents are accepted behavioral factors from DIFFERENT families
interaction-template-scales-6-8-accepted.evidence: R8: medband x volclock, fragility x vrburst, limit x turnself, semivol x volclock, gapvol x maxfreq, ampself x medband all in (always negative = agreement bearish). The two failures were sub-universe fails (maxeff x lowturn, rsq x turnlow at 1/3) — interactions involving turn_low lean small-cap.

robust-median-constructs-are-a-first-cla.name: robust-median-constructs-are-a-first-class
robust-median-constructs-are-a-first-cla.description: Robust/median constructs are a first-class family: median bands, mean-median gaps, median gap drift, and MAX-of-aggression
robust-median-constructs-are-a-first-cla.evidence: R8: gap_med60 (median overnight drift) OOS 0.051, mean_med_gap60 OOS 0.049, aggr_max (biggest close-vs-vwap push) OOS 0.083 — best of round; ret_amp_corr60 OOS 0.062. med_band120 died only at corr vs med_band60 (0.82) — one band per median construct.

band-separation-extends-to-regbeta-and-r.name: band-separation-extends-to-regbeta-and-remaining
band-separation-extends-to-regbeta-and-r.description: Band separation extends to RegBeta and remaining couplings (volresp60, lag2_60, aggr_attn_corr60 in; fragility60 died at the S4 OOS-ratio bar)
band-separation-extends-to-regbeta-and-r.evidence: R8: 5 more quarterly bands accepted. Also 2nd replacement executed: aggr_vr_corr displaced alpha_0042 at 0.84 corr.

robust-median-family-mvp-confirmed-media.name: robust-median-family-mvp-confirmed-median-daily
robust-median-family-mvp-confirmed-media.description: Robust/median family MVP confirmed: median daily range is the best OOS factor in the set
robust-median-family-mvp-confirmed-media.evidence: R9: hl_med60 (-TsMed(HIGH/LOW-1, 60)) OOS 0.094 (set-wide best); id_med60 accepted (median intraday drift, reversal direction); aggr_min (deepest capitulation close) OOS 0.059; semivol60 replaced skew-based alpha_0008 at 0.83 corr (3rd replacement). But robust framing does NOT rescue dead quantities: ret_med60/aggr_med60/mf_med60 all S1, amp_med_dev 0.94 corr.

slow-bands-keep-clearing-vol-term-slow.name: slow-bands-keep-clearing-vol-term-slow
slow-bands-keep-clearing-vol-term-slow.description: Slow bands keep clearing: vol_term_slow, semivol60, mf coupling 60d bands, signed_vr60; anti-intuitive attention-void factor works
slow-bands-keep-clearing-vol-term-slow.evidence: R9: vol_term_slow (60/250) OOS 0.052, mf_vwap_corr60 0.051, mf_amp_corr60 0.036; flat_open_freq (count of no-gap opens = attention void) OOS -0.047 with direction -1: neglected-open names outperform.

interaction-hit-rate-holds-at-scale-8.name: interaction-hit-rate-holds-at-scale-8
interaction-hit-rate-holds-at-scale-8.description: Interaction hit rate holds at scale (8/15) with two new failure signatures
interaction-hit-rate-holds-at-scale-8.evidence: R9: 8 accepted. Failures: ix_medband_gapvol 1/3 universes; ix_ovnmom_vrburst year-rate 0.71 (first S4 year-consistency kill); 5 S1 fails all had a CORR-construct parent — interactions want simple-quantity parents, not correlation parents.

what-survives-the-0-03-standard-median.name: what-survives-the-0-03-standard-median
what-survives-the-0-03-standard-median.description: What survives the 0.03 standard: median/robust, tails, vol shapes/terms, strong couplings + their bands, attention levels/clocks, band reversals
what-survives-the-0-03-standard-median.evidence: 69 survivors incl. hl_med60 0.094, max_eff 0.091, gap_vol 0.085, aggr_max 0.083, turn_low 0.080, vol_clock 0.076, intr_mom60 0.072, semivol60 0.070, med_band60 0.070. Target these classes; probes below ~0.04 IS IC will die at the OOS bar half the time.

under-the-0-03-standard-quarterly-condit.name: under-the-0-03-standard-quarterly-conditional
under-the-0-03-standard-quarterly-condit.description: Under the 0.03 standard: quarterly conditional aggregations and masked-std asymmetries are the fresh veins
under-the-0-03-standard-quarterly-condit.evidence: R10: ret_on_hivol60 OOS 0.082, aggr_hi_vr60 0.048, turn_updown_asym (std of turnover on up-days minus down-days) 0.068 — a NEW construct class; quarterly tails max_eff60 0.080 / aggr_max60 0.077 / min_eff60 0.058 cleared despite 20d siblings in the set (60d tails decorrelate enough, ~0.65).

semi-annual-120d-coupling-bands-still-cl.name: semi-annual-120d-coupling-bands-still-clear
semi-annual-120d-coupling-bands-still-cl.description: Semi-annual (120d) coupling bands still clear; 20d median drifts decorrelate from 60d
semi-annual-120d-coupling-bands-still-cl.evidence: R10: lag_chase120 0.041, ret_vr_corr120 0.037, attn_risk_corr120 0.031 (thin), gap_med20/id_med20 both in.

the-120d-band-tier-is-a-full.name: the-120d-band-tier-is-a-full
the-120d-band-tier-is-a-full.description: The 120d band tier is a full vein: conditionals, asymmetries, couplings, semivol, medians, event counts all clear there
the-120d-band-tier-is-a-full.evidence: R11: ret_on_hivol120 OOS 0.083, semivol120 0.079, mf_ret_corr120 0.056 (rescued a construct whose 60d died at corr), gap_med120, signed_vr120, maxfreq120, amp_burst120 all in. 120d decorrelates from both 20d and 60d siblings.

masked-std-asymmetry-generalizes-across-.name: masked-std-asymmetry-generalizes-across-quantities-amp
masked-std-asymmetry-generalizes-across-.description: Masked-std asymmetry generalizes across quantities (amp, turnover) and bands; idiosyncratic residual reversal works
masked-std-asymmetry-generalizes-across-.evidence: R11: amp_updown_asym OOS 0.076, turn_updown_60 0.059, attn_up_cnt 0.044, idio_rev (-TsSum(RegResi(RET,BENCH,60),20)) 0.043, aggr_min60 0.063, hl_term (median-range term ratio) 0.035. But idio_max died 0.91 vs max_eff and idio_med died S1 — only the REVERSAL transfers to residuals.

zero-return-frequency-lesmond-illiquidit.name: zero-return-frequency-lesmond-illiquidity-accepted-with
zero-return-frequency-lesmond-illiquidit.description: Zero-return frequency (Lesmond illiquidity) accepted with the illiquidity-premium sign; asymmetry family completes across bands
zero-return-frequency-lesmond-illiquidit.evidence: R12: zeroret_freq OOS |0.039| (more zero-return days -> higher forward returns, direction -1 on -count); aggr_updown_asym, turn_updown_120 in; amp_updown_60 REPLACED the 20d semivol asymmetry alpha_0078 at 0.83 corr / >=1.3x (4th replacement). ret_on_hivr120 OOS 0.085.

sign-counting-path-only-reversal-discard.name: sign-counting-path-only-reversal-discarding-magnitude
sign-counting-path-only-reversal-discard.evidence: R1: rev_path (-TsSum(Sign(RET),20)) ICIR 0.21 < 0.30, rejected S1. Magnitude information matters.

book-to-price-on-full-a-at.name: book-to-price-on-full-a-at
book-to-price-on-full-a-at.evidence: R1: bp_ind ICIR 0.24, rejected S1 (EP passed instead). Stale book values don't cross-sectionally discriminate at short horizons.

plain-volatility-amplitude-idio-vol-vari.name: plain-volatility-amplitude-idio-vol-variants-as
plain-volatility-amplitude-idio-vol-vari.description: Plain volatility/amplitude/idio-vol variants as standalone candidates
plain-volatility-amplitude-idio-vol-vari.evidence: R1: lowvol/amp_low/ivol died at dedup vs max_eff/turn_low. R2: vol_of_vol also died (corr 0.72 vs max_eff). The only vol construct that survived is the up/down SEMIVOL ASYMMETRY (alpha_0016, IS 0.062 -> OOS 0.067) — vol ideas must change the shape, not the scale.

plain-close-to-close-1-month-reversal.name: plain-close-to-close-1-month-reversal
plain-close-to-close-1-month-reversal.evidence: R1: rev20 and rev20_ind died at dedup vs intraday_rev. The intraday leg is the purer carrier; don't re-propose whole-return reversal.

over-saturating-one-family-in-a-single.name: over-saturating-one-family-in-a-single
over-saturating-one-family-in-a-single.description: Over-saturating one family in a single round
over-saturating-one-family-in-a-single.evidence: R1: 3 turnover factors + 3 volume-price factors accepted, several pairs near the 0.7 corr ceiling; marginal diversity per slot fell (set diversity 0.90). Cap ~2 candidates per family per round; the prompt explicitly lists over-saturation as a forbidden pattern.

classic-slow-risk-premia-beta-size-shape.name: classic-slow-risk-premia-beta-size-shape
classic-slow-risk-premia-beta-size-shape.description: Classic slow risk premia (beta, size shape, Amihud illiquidity) at the 10d horizon
classic-slow-risk-premia-beta-size-shape.evidence: R2: low_beta ICIR 0.08, size_nl -0.26, amihud ICIR 0.18 (IC 0.027 but unstable) — all S1 rejects. These axes need the 20d+ label or portfolio-level treatment, not 10d cross-sections.

price-path-shape-descriptors-trend-resid.name: price-path-shape-descriptors-trend-residual-r
price-path-shape-descriptors-trend-resid.description: Price-path shape descriptors (trend residual, R-squared trendiness, return autocorrelation, close position in range)
price-path-shape-descriptors-trend-resid.evidence: R2: resi_trend 0.08, rsq_choppy -0.08, ret_autocorr -0.09, close_pos 0.12 ICIR — the whole path-shape family is dead at 10d on full-A.

higher-tail-moments-beyond-max-skew-kurt.name: higher-tail-moments-beyond-max-skew-kurtosis
higher-tail-moments-beyond-max-skew-kurt.description: Higher tail moments beyond MAX/skew (kurtosis) and TTM earnings momentum via PctChange
higher-tail-moments-beyond-max-skew-kurt.evidence: R2: kurt ICIR -0.12 (max_eff+skew already span the tail); sue_ttm IC 0.018/cov 0.86 — TTM-delta earnings momentum too weak/slow; needs announcement-dated surprise, not rolling TTM drift.

treating-the-demeaned-rank-interaction-t.name: treating-the-demeaned-rank-interaction-template-as
treating-the-demeaned-rank-interaction-t.description: Treating the demeaned-rank interaction template as universal
treating-the-demeaned-rank-interaction-t.evidence: R3: gapvol_x_turn passed S1-S3 but FAILED stage 4 with 1/3 sub-universes (full-A-only effect = small-cap artifact); semivol_x_cfp died at S1 (value parents don't interact). The template only worked for behavioral-flow parent pairs (R2). Require both parents behavioral AND check sub-universe robustness expectation before spending a slot.

earnings-momentum-at-the-10d-horizon-in.name: earnings-momentum-at-the-10d-horizon-in
earnings-momentum-at-the-10d-horizon-in.description: Earnings momentum at the 10d horizon in ANY form (rolling TTM or announcement-dated revisions)
earnings-momentum-at-the-10d-horizon-in.evidence: R2: sue_ttm failed S1. R3: earn_rev60 passed IS (0.022/0.34) but stage-4 showed OOS 2022-23 collapse to -0.003 with year_rate 0.57 — regime-dead post-2021, first true OOS kill of the pipeline. Fundamentals only survive as LEVELS (EP/CFP yields), not changes.

composing-two-winning-transforms-and-ass.name: composing-two-winning-transforms-and-assuming-the
composing-two-winning-transforms-and-ass.description: Composing two winning transforms and assuming the composition wins (gap x asymmetry), turnover distribution shape (skew), accruals and nominal price at 10d
composing-two-winning-transforms-and-ass.evidence: R3: gap_asym ICIR -0.04 (asymmetry does not transfer to the overnight leg); turn_skew 0.01; accruals 0.20; price_nominal 0.07; exp_growth 0.21 (express coverage 0.70 is usable but the signal is weak). leg_vol_ratio -0.31 also sub-gate.

fundamental-levels-beyond-ep-cfp-at-the.name: fundamental-levels-beyond-ep-cfp-at-the
fundamental-levels-beyond-ep-cfp-at-the.description: Fundamental LEVELS beyond EP/CFP at the 10d horizon (quality is dead too)
fundamental-levels-beyond-ep-cfp-at-the.evidence: R4: roe_ind 0.20, opmargin_ind 0.17, cash_ratio 0.09, low_leverage 0.00, sp_ind 0.25, fcfp_ind 0.24 ICIR — ALL S1 rejects. Revises the R2 'levels survive' lesson: only direct price yields (EP, CFP) clear the bar, and value timing (ep_tsrank) died at stage 4 (2/3 universes, OOS 0.010).

management-guidance-forecast-midpoint-re.name: management-guidance-forecast-midpoint-regime-dead-oos
management-guidance-forecast-midpoint-re.description: Management guidance (forecast midpoint) — regime-dead OOS like all earnings-linked signals
management-guidance-forecast-midpoint-re.evidence: R4: fc_mid passed IS (0.027/0.34, coverage 0.88 fine) but stage-4 OOS -0.011, year rate 0.57. The fundamentals-that-move family (momentum, revisions, guidance) is uniformly dead post-2021.

monotone-transforms-reaggregations-of-an.name: monotone-transforms-reaggregations-of-an-accepted-factor
monotone-transforms-reaggregations-of-an.description: Monotone transforms / reaggregations of an accepted factor's core quantity (assume corr>0.7)
monotone-transforms-reaggregations-of-an.evidence: R4 S2 killed 9: outlier_habit~max_eff 0.78, ampresp_beta~turn_low 0.78, turn_conc~turn_cv 0.91, rev_skip~intraday_rev 0.89 (skip-window does NOT decorrelate), intraday_skew~skew 0.74 (leg lesson generalizes), upmove_share~intraday_rev 0.79, amp_spike~turn_spike 0.75, turn_trend~turn_spike 0.70, volresp_asym~volresp 0.74. Spend slots on new quantities, not new dressings.

anchor-position-constructs-52w-high-prox.name: anchor-position-constructs-52w-high-proximity-drawdown
anchor-position-constructs-52w-high-prox.description: Anchor/position constructs: 52w-high proximity, drawdown depth, open/vwap position in range, gap-fill tendency
anchor-position-constructs-52w-high-prox.evidence: R4: hi52 ICIR 0.04 (cov 0.82 also thin), dd_depth 0.09, vwap_pos 0.02, open_pos -0.26 (under IC bar), gap_fade 0.08 — the whole where-is-price-relative-to-anchor family is dead, matching R2's close_pos.

candle-anatomy-shadows-body-share-the-wh.name: candle-anatomy-shadows-body-share-the-whole
candle-anatomy-shadows-body-share-the-wh.description: Candle anatomy (shadows, body share) — the whole family is dead
candle-anatomy-shadows-body-share-the-wh.evidence: R5: upper_shadow 0.09, lower_shadow 0.26, shadow_asym 0.22, body_share 0.22 ICIR — all S1 rejects, like every other within-bar position construct (R2 close_pos, R4 vwap/open_pos).

self-rank-within-the-same-construct-and.name: self-rank-within-the-same-construct-and
self-rank-within-the-same-construct-and.description: Self-rank WITHIN the same construct and monotone shape variants (2nd confirmation wave)
self-rank-within-the-same-construct-and.evidence: R5 S2: amt_selfrank~turn_selfrank 0.96, pvcorr_selfrank~pv_corr 0.89, turn_medmean~turn_cv 0.75, cv_dispersion~turn_low 0.71, ret_on_hivol~semivol_asym 0.72 (the smart-money split is just semivol asymmetry in disguise), vol_share_up dup of signed_attn. Self-rank only works when applied to a DIFFERENT quantity than an accepted factor.

seasonality-echo-1y-whole-return-band-li.name: seasonality-echo-1y-whole-return-band-listing
seasonality-echo-1y-whole-return-band-li.description: Seasonality echo, 1y whole-return band, listing age, days-since-low, overnight continuation, conditional splits by market state
seasonality-echo-1y-whole-return-band-li.evidence: R5 S1: annual_echo -0.09, rev_1y 0.15 (cov 0.76 too), young_stock -0.04, lowday_close -0.24 under bar, overnight_contin -0.02, ret_on_mkt_tail 0.26, gap_x_vr -0.06, intr_on_downday -0.17, ret_on_lovol 0.18, down_elasticity -0.24, turn_trough_rec -0.23, rsq_turn 0.33 but IC 0.019, attn_rank_mom 0.17, limit_down_cnt 0.29.

flow-levels-and-accumulation-at-the-10d.name: flow-levels-and-accumulation-at-the-10d
flow-levels-and-accumulation-at-the-10d.description: Flow LEVELS and accumulation at the 10d horizon: moneyflow direction means, northbound deltas, margin balances
flow-levels-and-accumulation-at-the-10d.evidence: R6 S1 slaughter: all 11 moneyflow level/mean/divergence/consistency constructs ICIR<=0.24 except the corr; all 7 northbound (hk_level 0.21, deltas 0.24-0.29 — close but under); all margin levels (rz_level -0.14, rz_net20 0.29). Institutional positioning is priced or too slow at 10d; only its interaction with price moves carries signal.

tscorr-tsstd-on-0-filled-eligibility-fie.name: tscorr-tsstd-on-0-filled-eligibility-fields
tscorr-tsstd-on-0-filled-eligibility-fie.description: TsCorr/TsStd on 0-filled eligibility fields (HK/RZ) — zero variance makes NaN and craters coverage
tscorr-tsstd-on-0-filled-eligibility-fie.evidence: R6: hk_ret_corr cov 0.42, rz_ret_corr cov 0.37 (S1 coverage fail regardless of signal). Eligible-subset signals need subset-level evaluation or level-safe operators; don't spend full-A slots on them.

more-than-one-representative-per-event-t.name: more-than-one-representative-per-event-type
more-than-one-representative-per-event-t.description: More than one representative per event TYPE (limit-board variants collapse together)
more-than-one-representative-per-event-t.evidence: R6 S2: limit_close_cnt 0.87 and touch_no_close 0.73 vs alpha_0031 (limit_touch count) despite limit_close_cnt's stellar standalone IS 0.075/0.76; vr_std 0.80 vs turn_cv. One factor per event family.

lead-lag-flow-correlations-flow-leading-.name: lead-lag-flow-correlations-flow-leading-returns
lead-lag-flow-correlations-flow-leading-.description: Lead-lag flow correlations (flow leading returns, attention leading returns, flow chasing yesterday)
lead-lag-flow-correlations-flow-leading-.evidence: R7: mf_lead -0.13, vr_lead -0.26 at S1; mf_lag_chase passed IS then died OOS (-0.001, year 0.86). Timing information in flows does not survive; only contemporaneous coupling styles do.

crash-side-frequency-min-freq-tails-are.name: crash-side-frequency-min-freq-tails-are
crash-side-frequency-min-freq-tails-are.description: Crash-side FREQUENCY (min_freq) — tails are asymmetric: magnitude works on the down side, frequency only on the up side
crash-side-frequency-min-freq-tails-are.evidence: R7: min_freq ICIR 0.01 dead while max_freq (up) and min_eff (down magnitude) are both accepted factors.

second-representatives-per-quantity-even.name: second-representatives-per-quantity-event-7-more
second-representatives-per-quantity-even.description: Second representatives per quantity/event (7 more S2 kills), flow event structures beyond coupling
second-representatives-per-quantity-even.evidence: R7 S2: vr_on_up~signed_attn 0.98, one_word_rec~one_word_cnt 0.89, mf_sm_ret_corr~mf_ret_corr 0.79 (mechanical mirror), intr_burst_freq~max_freq 0.77, mf_on_limit~limit_touch 0.77, signed_amp~intraday_rev 0.75. S1: all MF event/recency/self-rank constructs (mf_lg_rec ICIR 0.50 but IC 0.017 under bar — flows are too weak cross-sectionally for event tricks).

hk-margin-in-any-form-at-10d.name: hk-margin-in-any-form-at-10d
hk-margin-in-any-form-at-10d.description: HK/margin in ANY form at 10d full-A — levels, deltas, ind-neutral deltas, dip-buying conditionals, burst counts all dead
hk-margin-in-any-form-at-10d.evidence: R8 closed the book: hk_dip 0.02, hk_d20_ind 0.26, rz_burst -0.06, hk_burst 0.14 after R6's level slaughter and R7's corr-coverage trap. Northbound/margin need 20d+ horizons or subset universes — stop spending 10d full-A slots.

new-high-new-low-making-frequency-condit.name: new-high-new-low-making-frequency-conditional
new-high-new-low-making-frequency-condit.description: New-high/new-low making frequency, conditional aggression splits, MF conditional sums
new-high-new-low-making-frequency-condit.evidence: R8 S1: lowmake_freq -0.23, himake_freq 0.19, aggr_on_down -0.24 (IC 0.034 but ICIR under), mf_on_shock 0.31/IC 0.016, gap_aggr_corr -0.01, ix parents from same quantity (ix_mfvwap_rev -0.44 but |IC| 0.015 under bar; ix_mineff_vrmean 0.14).

flow-moneyflow-beyond-contemporaneous-pr.name: flow-moneyflow-beyond-contemporaneous-price-action-coupling
flow-moneyflow-beyond-contemporaneous-pr.description: Flow (moneyflow) beyond contemporaneous price-action coupling — final verdict
flow-moneyflow-beyond-contemporaneous-pr.evidence: R9 closed it: mf_med60 0.22, mf_max -0.23, mf_dump_freq -0.20, mf_lg_med_dev -0.13 all S1. Across R6-R9 the ONLY flow survivors are TsCorr(MF_LG_NET, {RET, AMP, close/vwap}, {20,60}).

interactions-with-correlation-construct-.name: interactions-with-correlation-construct-parents-robust-reframings
interactions-with-correlation-construct-.description: Interactions with correlation-construct parents; robust reframings of already-dead quantities
interactions-with-correlation-construct-.evidence: R9: ix_retvr_medband, ix_mfret_gapvol, ix_lagchase_ampself all S1 (corr parents); doji_freq (freq rescue of dead body-share) -0.45 but |IC| 0.018 under, vwap_gap -0.02 (vwap-anchored gap adds nothing over close-anchored).

under-the-0-03-ic-standard-2026.name: under-the-0-03-ic-standard-2026
under-the-0-03-ic-standard-2026.description: Under the 0.03 IC standard (2026-07-07): demeaned-rank interactions rarely clear the bar — deprioritize
under-the-0-03-ic-standard-2026.evidence: Purge removed 13 of 15 interactions (their |IC| clusters 0.02-0.045 with OOS mostly <0.03). Only spend interaction slots when BOTH parents have |IS IC| >= 0.05, and expect most to fail.

under-the-0-03-standard-event-recency.name: under-the-0-03-standard-event-recency
under-the-0-03-standard-event-recency.description: Under the 0.03 standard: event-recency (HighDay-of-quantity) constructs decay below the bar OOS
under-the-0-03-standard-event-recency.evidence: Purged: amp_burst_rec (OOS 0.022), vr_burst_rec (0.015), gap_burst_rec (0.016), aggr_burst_rec (0.018), vol_peak_rec (0.015). Burst FREQUENCY holds; burst RECENCY doesn't.

shape-term-variants-of-resident-quantiti.name: shape-term-variants-of-resident-quantities-die
shape-term-variants-of-resident-quantiti.description: Shape/term variants of resident quantities die at S2 (12 kills); strong-parent interactions die at S1; 250d event counts die at the OOS bar
shape-term-variants-of-resident-quantiti.evidence: R10: medvol~hl_med60 0.89, upvol_share~semivol 0.95, idvol60~turn_low 0.72, vol_clock60~vol_clock 0.78, intraday_skew~semivol60 0.75 (retry failed against the replacement), hl_max~max_eff 0.71, gap_min~gap_vol 0.79; all 4 champion-parent interactions S1 (|IC| 0.007-0.027); limit_touch250 OOS 0.026 < 0.03.

midrange-median-tails-conditional-means-.name: midrange-median-tails-conditional-means-on-down
midrange-median-tails-conditional-means-.description: Midrange-median tails, conditional means on down-days/flows, gap-direction couplings; 60d conditional sums collide with intr_mom60
midrange-median-tails-conditional-means-.evidence: R11 S1: midrange_med/gap_midrange/aggr_midrange, mf_on_down60, aggr_on_down60, gap_on_hivr60, gap_after_down, mf_updown_asym, idio_med, gapabs_turn_corr60, gap_vr_corr60, turn_gap_corr, aggr_attn_corr120, gapdn_freq120, hl_med250. S2: ret_on_hivr60/ret_on_hiamp60/id_on_hivol60 all ~0.7 vs intr_mom60 (60d conditional RETURN sums are intr_mom60 in disguise — the 120d tier escapes).

the-s2-wall-at-100-factors-18.name: the-s2-wall-at-100-factors-18
the-s2-wall-at-100-factors-18.description: The S2 wall at 100+ factors: 18 corr-kills in one round — band extension is exhausted for most veins
the-s2-wall-at-100-factors-18.evidence: R12: amp_term_med corr 1.00 (!) vs hl_term, med_dev_vwap 0.99 vs med_band60, mf_ret_corr250 0.88 vs 120d, idio conditional/tail variants 0.85-0.86 vs residents. The annual (250d) tier also fails S4 (lag_chase250 OOS 0.022). The formulaic OHLCV+flow space against this set is effectively mined out; further growth needs new DATA, replacements, or a different label horizon.

turnover-spike-rarity-calm-attention-tur.name: turnover-spike-rarity-calm-attention-turn-f
turnover-spike-rarity-calm-attention-tur.evidence: New robust event_freq quantity: -TsCount(TURN_F>2*mean,120) clears S2 (0.66), IS 0.047, and is valid+efficient in 2026 (sIC 0.071, net +15%, turn 0.37). Calm-attention names outperform. calm on amount/retshock S2-lock vs existing amp/vr/vol reps.

median-mean-ratio-of-dollar-volume-robus.name: median-mean-ratio-of-dollar-volume-robust
median-mean-ratio-of-dollar-volume-robus.description: median-mean RATIO of dollar volume (robust family extends to AMOUNT)
median-mean-ratio-of-dollar-volume-robus.evidence: TsMed(AMOUNT,60)/TsMean is robust (IS 0.042) AND valid+efficient in 2026 (sIC 0.057, net +8.3%). RATIO (bounded, low turnover) survives 2026 costs where mean-median GAP does not.

median-mean-gap-valid-but-cost-inefficie.name: median-mean-gap-valid-but-cost-inefficient
median-mean-gap-valid-but-cost-inefficie.description: median-mean GAP: valid but cost-inefficient in 2026
median-mean-gap-valid-but-cost-inefficie.evidence: Mean-median GAP (amp/absret/amount, 60/120) pass every 2017-25 gate AND stay valid in 2026 (sIC 0.05-0.06) but are NOT cost-efficient in 2026 (net -8 to -11%). Validity != tradability; prefer RATIO over GAP.

attention-risk-couplings-die-under-neutr.name: attention-risk-couplings-die-under-neutralized-gating
attention-risk-couplings-die-under-neutr.description: attention-risk couplings die under neutralized gating
attention-risk-couplings-die-under-neutr.evidence: Coupling correlations (TsCorr TURN_F/absRET, amp/vr, vr/ret) neutralize to ~0 IC under GATE_ON_NEUTRALIZED; coup(VR,RET,120)=exact dup of alpha_0113. Coupling vein largely dead post-neutralization except fresh flow pairs.

beta-instability-systematic-share-decays.name: beta-instability-systematic-share-decays-oos-in
beta-instability-systematic-share-decays.evidence: beta_instability -TsStd(RegBeta(RET,BENCH,20),60) strong 2017-25 (OOS 0.076) but decays below bar in 2026 (sIC 0.024) = regime-dependent. rsq_bench term-structure S2-locks vs existing systematic-share.

northbound-flow-acceleration.name: northbound-flow-acceleration
northbound-flow-acceleration.hypothesis: Levels/deltas of HK_RATIO were dead at 10d; the acceleration of foreign accumulation may be the event that prices.

margin-unwind-events.name: margin-unwind-events
margin-unwind-events.description: Detect forced-deleveraging days from margin balance drops
margin-unwind-events.hypothesis: Sharp financing-balance contractions on down days may mark capitulation the flow-level factors cannot see.
